0022600163.text: The 76ers (6-1, first in the Atlantic and East) host the Bulls (1-5, 13th in the East) in Philadelphia's 8th game of the season, with the 76ers on a three-game winning streak and 3-0 on the road, while Chicago has lost four straight and sits fourth in the Central, 4 games back. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision, while Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers lost 1-2 to the Bulls in the 2025-26 season series before beating them 157-137 in Philadelphia on 2026-03-25.
